description: This Java source file contains abstract unit tests for verifying the registration and presence of command response classes annotated with @JsonParsableCommandResponse in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The tests ensure proper classpath inclusion, annotations, and method presence related to command responses.

classes.name: GlobalCommandResponseRegistryTestCases
classes.description: An abstract test class that verifies the registration, annotation, and classpath presence of command response classes with @JsonParsableCommandResponse annotation in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: GlobalCommandResponseRegistryTestCases
methods.description: Constructor that initializes sample classes for testing command responses, requiring at least one class annotated with @JsonParsableCommandResponse.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Junit setup method that populates the list of JSON parsable command response classes found in classpath, excluding 'TestCommandResponse'.

methods.name: sampleCheckForCommandResponseFromEachModule
methods.description: Test to verify that all command response classes are present in the classpath.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: Test to ensure the sample classes cover all package modules with command responses.

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method extracting distinct package sets from class iterables.

methods.name: allCommandResponsesRegistered
methods.description: Test to verify all concrete subclasses of CommandResponse (except acknowledgements) are annotated with @JsonParsableCommandResponse.

methods.name: allRegisteredCommandResponsesContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: Test to verify that every class annotated with @JsonParsableCommandResponse has the designated method to parse from JSON.

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Validates that annotated command response classes include the method specified in their annotation for deserialization.
